errors.PIN_WEAK: This PIN is too easy to guess. Choose another one.

errors.INACTIVE: This user is not active. Contact the maintenance manager.
errors.NO_SESSION: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.MUST_CHANGE_PIN: You must choose a new PIN first.
errors.OFFLINE: No connection. Signing in needs internet the first time.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Try again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
errors.UNKNOWN_ACTION: This app version does not match the server. Update the app.
